2608.00582.title: Writing-System-Level Tokenizer Adaptation for Byte-Level BPE
2608.00582.paper_summary: Pretrained byte-level BPE tokenizers can segment underrepresented languages inefficiently. Replacing a tokenizer changes the meaning of nearly every token ID, while vocabulary expansion enlarges the model's embedding and output matrices. We study post-hoc adaptation that keeps the model-vocabulary size fixed and preserves most existing token-to-ID assignments as a construction-time compatibility property. Directly transferring tokens from a language-specific tokenizer does not guarantee derivability through the target BPE merge graph: an inserted entry can conflict with the target's greedy merge ranks. We formalize this failure as the merge ordering problem and introduce BPE-guided insertion, which builds each transferred token through a target-reachable decomposition. Our pipeline uses script-aware row selection to limit collateral fragmentation, reconstructs target-script byte-level prerequisites, and applies guided insertion to maintain merge-graph reachability. On Ukrainian adaptations of Nemotron and GPT-OSS, it reduces token counts by 33.5% and 36.6%, keeps changes on English and the evaluated four-language European aggregate within 0.05%, and retains 78.5%/77.3% of original model-vocabulary rows at the same IDs. Constraint-matched global and frequency-based removal achieve similar Ukrainian compression but increase English/European token counts by 0.7-2.2%; fresh same-size retraining compresses Ukrainian slightly more but retains effectively no same-ID rows and increases English token counts by 7.6-8.6%. The reallocation increases token counts on the evaluated three-language Cyrillic micro-aggregate by 6.7%/10.1%. Structural audits find all 28,134/45,398 inserted BPE nodes reachable under ordinary rank-ordered merging and no retained same-ID model-vocabulary entry newly broken. We release all tokenizers and code.
2608.00582.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練的字節級 BPE 分詞器可能會低效地切分未被充分代表的語言。更換分詞器會改變幾乎每個標記 ID 的含義，而詞彙擴展則會擴大模型的嵌入和輸出矩陣。我們研究後期適應，保持模型詞彙大小固定，並保留大多數現有的標記到 ID 的分配，作為構建時的相容性屬性。直接從特定語言的分詞器轉移標記並不保證可以通過目標 BPE 合併圖進行推導：插入的條目可能與目標的貪婪合併排名衝突。我們將這一失敗形式化為合併排序問題，並引入 BPE 引導插入，通過目標可達的分解構建每個轉移的標記。我們的管道使用腳本感知的行選擇來限制附帶碎片，重建目標腳本的字節級前提，並應用引導插入以保持合併圖的可達性。在烏克蘭語的 Nemotron 和 GPT-OSS 的適應中，標記數量減少了 33.5% 和 36.6%，對英語和評估的四語言歐洲總和的變化保持在 0.05% 以內，並在相同 ID 下保留了 78.5%/77.3% 的原始模型詞彙行。約束匹配的全局和基於頻率的刪除實現了類似的烏克蘭壓縮，但英語/歐洲的標記數量增加了 0.7-2.2%；新鮮的同尺寸再訓練稍微壓縮了烏克蘭，但有效保留了幾乎沒有相同 ID 的行，並使英語標記數量增加了 7.6-8.6%。重新分配使評估的三語西里爾微總和的標記數量增加了 6.7%/10.1%。結構審核發現所有 28,134/45,398 個插入的 BPE 節點在普通排名有序合併下都是可達的，並且沒有保留的相同 ID 模型詞彙條目被新破壞。我們釋放所有分詞器和代碼。
2608.00582.author: Bohdan Didenko et.al.
